title: Mikel Arteta: Overturning Eberechi Eze penalty ‘completely unacceptable’, ‘changes course of tie’
content:
Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta called the decision to overturn a penalty awarded for a challenge on Eberechi Eze during Wednesday’s draw with Atletico Madrid “completely unacceptable”

Referee Danny Makkelie had pointed to the spot in the 78th minute of the Champions League semi-final first leg with the score 1-1 after David Hancko appeared to make contact with Eze’s right foot in the penalty area.

Arteta argued Makkelie’s call to go back on his decision after consulting the pitch-side monitor “changes the course of the tie”.

The noise at the Metropolitano Stadium rose throughout the VAR check, while Atletico head coach Diego Simeone left his technical area and was in close proximity to the monitor as Makkelie reviewed the incident, gesturing for him to overturn his decision.

Arsenal had led in the first half through a Viktor Gyokeres penalty after Hancko was penalised for a foul on the Arsenal striker — a decision Simeone questioned at full time.

Atletico equalised 11 minutes into the second half, Julian Alvarez converting from the penalty spot after Marcos Llorente’s volley bounced and struck Ben White’s hand. A penalty was awarded by Makkelie after he consulted the pitch-side monitor, and Arteta had no issue with the decision.

“It is a rule and they’ve been quite consistent with that one,” he said. “On that one if you’re going to give a penalty for this kind of thing, you have to accept it. I have nothing to say with that. The one that changes completely everything, is the penalty on Ebs (Eze), and that cannot happen at this level.”

Simeone told a press conference: “The first penalty, the player waited for the contact and went down. I think in a Champions League semi-final it has to be a clear penalty. But the referee understood it was a penalty.

“Thanks to VAR the handball was seen, and thanks to VAR the other (Arsenal) penalty was overturned. Sometimes VAR gives to you, sometimes it takes away.”

The two sides meet at the Emirates Stadium in the return leg on Tuesday.
